narration: First, a 3D Gaussian Splatting scene is reconstructed from multi-view images and masks, allowing rendering of multi-view depth maps with the initial bear statue.
Next, using the rendered depth maps and input masks, background regions from neighboring views are projected into the reference view to geometrically infer an accurate depth-guided inpainting mask.
Then, the reference view is inpainted and lifted into a 3D point cloud via depth-guided projection, initializing the refined Gaussian splatting model without the bear.
The 3D point cloud is projected to other viewpoints, and the refined model renders novel views, enforced by a cross-view consistency loss L_cross.
Finally, reference views and depths are rendered from the model and compared against the inpainted reference using render loss L_render in an iterative refinement loop.
The entire pipeline synergizes depth-guided mask inference and multi-view consistency to achieve seamless 3D object removal and scene completion.
